laws.text: Lov om Norges Flag (flaggloven), LOV-1898-12-10-1, section 1

meta.name: Norway
notes: From the law: every proportion, in section 1, and the colors in words, høirødt, mørkeblaat and white. The 1927 flag regulation repeats the same figures.
From elsewhere: the law names no color system. The hex, Pantone and CMYK values are the Album des Pavillons 2023's, as reported by FOTW.
FOTW also reports semi-official Pantone matches from the Foreign Ministry and a de facto Pantone 200 among flag makers, kept as references. Sources conflict, and none of these is legal.
Amendments: Lovdata's current text shows no amending law, only a 2023 correction of the commencement date.
